integrity: The sharp six/seven-side threshold follows from exact rational interval cap comparisons for n=3..11 and a monotone disk upper majorant for n>=11. Previous all-polygon norm and disk asymptotic formulas are acknowledged as existing mathematics.
scientific_limitations: Revised claim is only the strict norm-2/half-range positivity crossover for real affine area projections on filled regular polygons. Existing exact norm formulas, vertex normers, and disk asymptotics are excluded from novelty. Potential implicit earlier coverage remains.
title: Sharp six-to-seven-side stability threshold for affine least squares on filled regular polygons
